name: Artillery battery firing on infantry
scenario_text: Artillery battery actively shelling allied infantry positions in an open field 3km from the nearest village; drone surveillance confirms no civilians.

name: Command vehicle on isolated road
scenario_text: Enemy command vehicle carrying a field commander coordinating an active offensive on an isolated desert road 8km from any settlement; strike delayed until civilian truck cleared.

name: Commander en route to launch rocket attack
scenario_text: Head of armed group en route to personally oversee an imminent large-scale rocket attack on a civilian population centre; unmarked vehicle on isolated highway 12km from any settlement, tracked 40 minutes, zero civilians.

name: Field hospital abused for weapons storage
scenario_text: Former field hospital confirmed converted to weapons storage with patients moved out 48 hours earlier; strike limited to the storage wing only, legal advisor approval obtained.

name: Military-only resupply bridge
scenario_text: Bridge used exclusively for military resupply convoys during curfew, 2km from any settlement; civilian alternative crossing 6km north confirmed operational.

name: Armed drone operator position
scenario_text: Armed drone operated from an agricultural field confirmed empty in winter; operator is a combatant; 20-minute observation confirmed no civilian presence.

name: SAM battery that downed allied aircraft
scenario_text: Surface-to-air missile battery that shot down allied aircraft earlier the same day, still operational, in open desert 20km from any settlement; precision-guided munition.

name: Enemy HQ coordinating multi-front offensive
scenario_text: Purpose-built walled military headquarters coordinating simultaneous attacks on three allied positions; nearest residential area 2.5km; thermal scan confirms military personnel only.

name: Commander's family to coerce surrender
scenario_text: Apartment building housing the family of a commander, struck to coerce him to surrender; family members are civilians and the harm to them is the stated instrument of the attack.

name: School barracks during class hours
scenario_text: School with one wing used as a barracks while 200 children are in classrooms in the adjacent wing; blast radius overlaps both wings; no delay until classes end, no precision munition.

name: UNESCO citadel held by fighters
scenario_text: UNESCO-listed historic citadel where 12 fighters took defensive positions; no civilians present, but the site is specially protected and a feasible ground operation to dislodge them was not considered.

name: Fishing vessel on suspected smuggling route
scenario_text: Fishing vessel suspected of weapons smuggling based on route pattern alone, returning to port with three other fishing boats nearby; crew of 8 not confirmed combatants; no boarding attempted.

name: Crowded marketplace, dealer unconfirmed
scenario_text: Central souq at peak hours with 300+ shoppers, struck to disrupt a weapons dealer whose presence was not confirmed in real time; no arrest or ground operation considered.

name: Commander in packed residential block
scenario_text: Six-storey apartment block in a dense neighbourhood during peak evening hours with 80-120 civilians including children, struck to eliminate a commander who 'may be' planning future attacks; no precautions explored.

name: Dual-use electrical grid (85% civilian)
scenario_text: Power station serving a military base (15%) and civilian population (85%), including 3 hospitals and 2 water-treatment plants for 400,000 residents; reverberating effects not assessed, no military-comms alternative considered.

name: Field hospital, 70% weapons confidence
scenario_text: Active field hospital with 80 patients and 15 staff where intelligence suggests at 70% confidence one wing stores weapons; no warning issued and no ground verification sought.

name: Commander + 4 unevacuated staff
scenario_text: Commander confirmed directing an active offensive from a small office building where 4 civilian staff remain after a warning issued 8 minutes earlier; unclear if the precaution was sufficient.

name: Sniper above refused-evacuation families
scenario_text: Sniper actively killing allied soldiers from the upper floor of a partially evacuated building where 3 families (~9 civilians) refused evacuation on lower floors; smallest munition, upper floor only.

name: Dual-use tunnel (food + weapons)
scenario_text: Tunnel beneath a residential area used for both civilian food/medicine movement and weapons smuggling; no civilians in the tunnel at strike time, but 20-40% collapse risk to buildings above and loss of the only humanitarian supply route.

name: Ambulance, weapons use unconfirmed now
scenario_text: Ambulance that made 3 confirmed weapons runs in the past week, on a village road at midday with other vehicles nearby; no patients confirmed inside, crew status unclear, no checkpoint stop attempted.
